key: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). source: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.

Mintga tank supplementar dovra ses agen PID supplementar da Torque (MCU Mode 22, num unic — betg 012F ni Ford 16C1). La valur da Select-PID è l'id dal tank cumenzond cun 1. Gal/hr vegn mo mess al tank activ.

key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Cumenzament svelt
1. Installescha Torque Pro (la versiun pajada; Torque Lite na sustegna nagins plugins) e pareglia tes adapter OBD-II.
2. Activescha quest plugin en Torque → Parameters → Plugins.
3. Permetta avis e metta l'utilisaziun da la batteria sin Senza restricziuns, uschia che Torque po aviar quest plugin en il fund davos.
4. En Torque tscherna il profil dal vehichel per l'auto che ti mainas. Las datas vegnan tegnidas per profil da Torque e cumparegliadas cun l'identitad VIN/ECU dal vehichel.
5. Tar in nov profil vegn la funtauna da carburant scuvrida cura che ti collieschas; sche ti vegns dumandà, cumpareglia ella cun l'indicatur sin il tablou e smatga sin Confermar. Confermar è sin la pagina da configuraziun ed en l'avis. Ti pos era la tscherner sut.
6. Qua na dat nagina grondezza dal tank d'endatar. Mintga agiustament emprende sia grondezza, mussada sut Grondezza dal tank emprendida; enfin lura legia ses procent curregì 1:1 cun l'indicatur. Endatescha la grondezza dal tank en il profil da vehichel da Torque per il carburant che resta ed il DTE da Torque sez.
7. En Torque agiunta indicaturs per [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level e per mintga agiustament Corrected % e Tank size. Il plugin na publitgescha ni carburant che resta ni DTE. In avis durant ina reagiustaziun di che quel agiustament legia 1:1 fin che la reagiustaziun è finida.
8. Returna il livel da carburant a Torque: Orà, Llischà u Curregì da l'agiustament Chunk, Band u Kalman sin tes indicatur 012F. Il carburant che resta ed il DTE da Torque sez dovran lura quel livel cun la grondezza dal tank ed il mpg a lunga vista dal profil da Torque.
9. Carburant vegn mo dumbrà durant che il motor va. Il plugin va mo durant che Torque è collià cun l'ECU.
10. Continuescha a manar ed a plainar; la precision crescha sur plirs tanks parzials. Sche il plugin na po betg dir tge vehichel che quai è, dumonda el en in avis e sin questa pagina; tscherna tge far cun quella cursa.
11. Tut las datas restan sin quest telefon. Nagina GPS ni posiziun vegn registrada.
